announcements.title: Stake Temple Trip
announcements.content: The stake is organizing a temple trip to the Boise Idaho Temple next Saturday. The bus will leave from the stake center at 5:30am and return by 8pm.

announcements.title: Ward Christmas Party
announcements.content: Save the date for our annual ward Christmas party on December 20th. Sign up to help with decorations or bring a side dish.

announcements.title: Youth Activity
announcements.content: All youth ages 12-18 are invited to a special activity this Friday evening from 7-9pm in the cultural hall.

announcements.title: Relief Society Meeting
announcements.content: Relief Society will meet this Tuesday at 7pm to work on service projects for the local homeless shelter.

announcements.title: Primary Program Practice
announcements.content: Primary children should attend practice this Saturday at 10am. Parents please help your children memorize their parts.
